criteria.description: The executor validates the complete failover recipe and action parameters before starting step 1.
Failover steps execute sequentially and emit run started, step started, step progress, and run completed events.
A failed failover step stops the run, emits step and run failure events, and does not start later steps or rollback automatically.
Context cancellation cancels the active step and prevents later failover steps from starting.
Only one continuity recipe run per service key is active in-process at a time.
